# A SUMMARY.md link to another site stays a link to that site. It is
# shown in the sidebar and is not a page to step to.

md2html -nav -html out src

grep -q 'href="https://pkg.go.dev/example.com/x" class="nav-external"' out/intro.html
! grep 'pkg.go.dev[^"]*\.html' out/intro.html
grep -q 'href="guide.html" class="nav-next"' out/intro.html

-- src/SUMMARY.md --
# Summary

- [Intro](intro.md)
- [API Reference](https://pkg.go.dev/example.com/x)
- [Guide](guide.md)

-- src/intro.md --
# Intro
